name: rolling_forecast
title: Rolling forecast 3+9 by product, FY2026
purpose: Closed months from landed sales, open months from a run rate and a growth driver per product, switched at the last actual month; full-year outlook against budget, with a cumulative corkscrew.
limitations: Template of the rule-of-thumb-model plugin: the sales data are generated by make_data.py (seed 20261125); growth and budget are invented.
The run rate is the average of the actual months; the forecast month value is the run rate times (1 + monthly growth), without compounding.

The monthly roll moves the end date of the contract's source.where to the new closing date (the contract is agreed again), lands the new sales, changes last_actual, actual_months and forecast_months in model.spec.json and rebuilds; the check closed_months_landed fails while an actual month holds no landed row (README "The monthly roll").

items.label: Closed months with no sales, confirmed with the source
items.source: source system: months the source confirms had no sale
items.note: The check closed_months_landed compares this number with the actual months that hold no landed sales row. Raise it only after the source confirmed that a closed month had no sale (README "The monthly roll").

items.label: Display scale (fixed at 1000)
items.note: Fixed: the budget and every unit label of this template are in KRW thousand. A model in another unit needs the budget retyped and the labels changed (README).

items.label: Products
items.source: contract sales, allowed values of product

items.label: Monthly growth over the run rate

Run rate check: rate x months less actual, absolute

Actual month with no landed row (1)

sheets.name: summary
sheets.purpose: full-year outlook against budget: the key result

checks.label: Actual block total equals the raw sales total
Actual months input equals the months flagged actual on the timeline
Actual months plus forecast months equals the timeline length
Run rates times actual months equal the actual total
Looked-up growth equals the growth inputs
Outlook total equals actuals plus forecast months at run rate times (1 + growth)
Cumulative outlook in December equals the outlook total
Full-year variance % times budget equals outlook less budget (budget not 0)
checks.note: A budget total of 0 gives 0 % (IFERROR in Variance %) and the check then compares 0 with 0.

checks.label: Largest per-product difference of run rate x actual months and actuals
checks.note: runrate_ties compares sums only: a run rate that is the same for every product can pass it. This check reads each product's run rate.

checks.label: Actual months with no landed row equal the closed months confirmed with no sales
checks.note: An actual month with no landed row fails it: the contract's source.where still ends before last_actual, or the month had no sale (raise closed_months_no_sales only after the source confirmed it; README "The monthly roll").

notes.text: The growth lookup sits in its own helper block: IF(INDEX(MATCH())) in one cell would nest three functions.

The extract ends at the end date in the contract's source.where (shipped: 2026-03-31), so the actual block shows 0 for the months after it. The monthly roll moves that date (README "The monthly roll").
